# PRD: <product name>

Copy this file to `docs/prd.md` and fill it in during `/liftoff` Step 2. The
user approves this document before Step 3 (specs) starts.

## Problem

The problem this product solves, stated without reference to the solution.

## User

The one concrete persona this is built for first — not "everyone."

## Jobs

The 2-4 concrete jobs this user hires the product to do (job-to-be-done
framing: "when I ___, I want to ___, so I can ___").

## Features (3-5, v1 only)

The smallest feature set that delivers the core job — each one becomes a
`docs/specs/` entry once approved here.

1.
2.
3.

## Not in v1

What's explicitly deferred — the point is to keep v1 small on purpose, not
to forget these; they're candidates for `docs/roadmap.md`'s Later column.

## Success metric

The one number that tells you this is working (e.g. "10 users complete the
core action twice in a week"), and how you'll observe it (see the analytics
playbook).

## Status

`draft` / `approved` — the `/liftoff` skill will not proceed to Step 3 until
this reads `approved`.
